reviews.author: Umran C…
reviews.body: Ever since I moved to Miami, I've had trouble finding a good hairstylist for my naturally curly hair. A friend from school recommended Seissa to me, so I decided to try her out yesterday. I'm glad I did because she's a professional hairstylist who knows how to make sure you're happy with the result. First, I got my hair washed with a shampoo specifically chosen for curly hair. It smelled amazing, and my hair's texture after the wash was fantastic. Then, I got an excellent haircut that was exactly what I wanted. It's worth noting that the staff there is very kind and friendly, and they want you to feel at home and relax. Thank you, Seissa, and everyone who worked there to contribute to a great experience.
